text: ＊は　まひして　わざが　でにくくなった！

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい after a verb stem means hard to do. にくくなる means it becomes hard to do. でにくくなった = 'became hard to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: て joins two events, here the cause and then the result. まひして　でにくくなった = 'is paralyzed and so it is hard to move'.
